title: Amulet of the block
description: A gilded and golden resource pack.
body:
This is **~Amulet of the Block~** a gilded and golden resource pack for those who love gold like me. it changes the textures of the  hearts, XP bar, XP bar numbers, crosshair, hunger bar, different items (see gallery photo) and particles as well as the attack indicator.

Now supports appleskin!
Use CIT resewn and polytone or optifine for all the features to work.
